title: Webhook Reliability and Alert Deduplication
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Webhook Reliability and Alert Deduplication.
learning_objectives: Explain webhook reliability and alert deduplication using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for webhook reliability and alert deduplication
Assess failure and operational limits of webhook reliability and alert deduplication
concepts_covered: Alerts should avoid repeated notifications for the same transition; webhook retry behavior is in the dispatcher, not implied by the model.
Alert history and channel dispatch are implemented in core/dispatch.py; verify retry and mute semantics before relying on them.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
